event_text: The companies confirm unauthorized access to the Mitsui Shopping Park app, stop the app and find that some member data leaked
The companies announce the leak and the app's suspension; the number of people affected is still being investigated
The companies say data on about 3,119,000 members leaked, including phone numbers and gender, and that they have identified how the intruder got in
The companies announce that the Mitsui Shopping Park app has restarted
notes: Date on the notice; no time given.
